run.description: Add the source a file declares, or replace the one of its name
does: it adds one source and copies 3 command files (7 commands), and changes nothing else. It grants no call, makes no hook, and sets no credential's file.

source synthetic: its calls go to https://api.example.invalid. Its credential is the variable SRC_TOK (the name, never the value), with SRC_UPD for updates, minted from MINT_A and MINT_B and MINT_C and MINT_D by the declaration's own mint command [bin/mint, --v1] (command file bin/mint, copied to <home>/sources/synthetic/bin/mint: sha256 852df76bdccdcb7435e1d65b711dc6ba2a562a711d2a61ef2a5ed58aeb136274, mode 0700), run with the mint's inputs and the operator's local logins where the source's mint_command is unset: one the operator sets wins over it, sent in the header "Authorization: Bearer {credential}" on every call.

call fetch (read): GET /items. It takes q (enum, optional, one of open, closed, its value is kept in the record of each call) and pat (string, optional, pattern ^[a-z]+$, at most 20), and sends the query q={q}, empty="".
call fetch sends no body. Its answer keeps id, title, at most 4096 bytes.
call mk (update): POST /items. It takes p (string, required), and sends no query.

call mk builds its body with the command [bin/builder, --json], run with the credential at each call and free to make its own requests with it while it builds. Its answer is returned as it comes, at most 65536 bytes.
call tellcall (update): POST /tell. It takes to (string, required), t (string, required), x (string, required) and l (string, optional), and sends no query.
call tellcall sends the body {"link":"{l}","text":"{x}","title":"{t}","to":"{to}"}. Its answer is returned as it comes, at most 65536 bytes.
Its check call is fetch, and updates carry their key in the header X-Req-Id.
it can tell a user: the call tellcall, whose to takes the person's address, read as HEAR_ADDR from the person's own env file; the title fills t and the text fills x and the link fills l.
it hears deliveries: only one whose sender is the address of a user told through it, read as , and every told user's: another's, and a stranger's, is dropped after verification.
its limits command [bin/report, limits, {provider}] says what the subscription of claude as pro still carries.

it speaks in threads: a place to open one is called issue; the words state takes are started, review, done; it takes labels (label:<name> adds one, never removes); an assignee is a person's key in the source.

its issues are a bead's link: host example.invalid, the expression ^/(org/repo)/i/([0-9]+)$ reads an issue, the one fixed form https://example.invalid/{1}/i/{2} and the thread id {2}; the groups fold lower. Its pull requests read ^/(org/repo)/pr/([0-9]+)$, with the fixed form https://example.invalid/{1}/pr/{2} and the thread id {2}. A repository's path matches ^(org/repo)$.
its identity keys fold to lowercase (identity fold: lower), so one spelling is stored however it was typed.

what it sends in: deliveries are verified by HMAC-SHA512 over v0:{timestamp}:{body} (scheme hmac-sha256, algorithm: sha512, signed: v0:{timestamp}:{body}), the signature in the header X-Sig as hex, one or more separated by ",", each past the prefix "sha512=", any one of them passing; the HMAC key is what follows the prefix "whsec_" in the secret, read as hex (not the secret's own bytes); a delivery is named by deliv.id in its body; its time arrives at ts, in ms within 5m of the yard's clock; bodies are unique; the command [bin/report, norm] turns a verified body into the envelope, handed no credential; its events may carry the fields sender, repo.

what it sends of pull requests and CI: the envelope types ci are runs; push tell a head; the command [bin/report, pr] reads the pull request, handed the credential; the command [bin/report, ci] reads CI, handed the credential.

command file bin/report: [bin/report, limits, {provider}] (limits.command, handed no credential), [bin/report, open] (thread.open, handed the credential), [bin/report, norm] (hook.normalize, handed no credential), [bin/report, pr] (events.pr, handed the credential) and [bin/report, ci] (events.ci, handed the credential): sha256 852df76bdccdcb7435e1d65b711dc6ba2a562a711d2a61ef2a5ed58aeb136274, mode 0700
command file bin/builder: [bin/builder, --json] (call.mk.build, handed the credential): sha256 852df76bdccdcb7435e1d65b711dc6ba2a562a711d2a61ef2a5ed58aeb136274, mode 0700
still owed after it: the credential, by a secret ask for synthetic; and which user it tells, by yardr user set <user> notify=synthetic.

carried.name: synthetic
carried.text:
name: synthetic
base: https://api.example.invalid
bases:
  eu: https://eu.example.invalid
credential:
  env: SRC_TOK
  update_env: SRC_UPD
  header: "Authorization: Bearer {credential}"
  mint:
    - name: MINT_A
      secret: true
    - MINT_B
    - MINT_C
    - MINT_D
  mint_command: [bin/mint, --v1]
calls:
  fetch:
    kind: read
    params:
      q: {type: enum, values: [open, closed], optional: true, log: true}
      pat: {type: string, pattern: "^[a-z]+$", max: 20, optional: true}
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /items
      query: {q: "{q}", empty: ""}
    answer:
      select: [id, title]
      max: 4096
  mk:
    kind: update
    request: {method: POST, path: /items}
    build: [bin/builder, --json]
    params:
      p: {type: string}
  tellcall:
    kind: update
    params:
      to: {type: string}
      t: {type: string}
      x: {type: string}
      l: {type: string, optional: true}
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /tell
      body: {to: "{to}", title: "{t}", text: "{x}", link: "{l}"}
check: fetch
idempotency: X-Req-Id
notify:
  call: tellcall
  address: {param: to, env: HEAR_ADDR}
  title: t
  text: x
  link: l
hear:
  field: sender
  by: identity
limits:
  command: [bin/report, limits, "{provider}"]
  kinds: {claude: pro}
thread:
  open: [bin/report, open]
  place: issue
  states: [started, review, done]
  labels: true
  assignee: key
link:
  host: example.invalid
  issue: "^/(org/repo)/i/([0-9]+)$"
  fixed: "https://example.invalid/{1}/i/{2}"
  thread: "{2}"
  fold: lower
  pull:
    issue: "^/(org/repo)/pr/([0-9]+)$"
    fixed: "https://example.invalid/{1}/pr/{2}"
    thread: "{2}"
  repos: "^(org/repo)$"
identity:
  fold: lower
events:
  runs: [ci]
  head_from: [push]
  pr: [bin/report, pr]
  ci: [bin/report, ci]
hook:
  verify:
    scheme: hmac-sha256
    algorithm: sha512
    signed: "v0:{timestamp}:{body}"
    signature: {header: X-Sig, encoding: hex, list: ",", prefix: "sha512="}
    key: {encoding: hex, prefix: "whsec_"}
    delivery: {body: deliv.id}
    timestamp: {body: ts, unit: ms, window: 5m}
  bodies: unique
  normalize: [bin/report, norm]
  keys: [sender, repo]

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: the command file bin/mint of synthetic (new), bin/report of synthetic (new) and bin/builder of synthetic (new)
